thread:
sarah: Heads up 12: saw a burst of connector handshake failures from Private tenants in eu-west. Symptoms: short-lived 502s, and a few TLS verify errors. Not the same as the earlier NAT-window issue. Anyone seen this pattern?

ben: Yup, spotted it in tracing. Two separate failure buckets: 
- TLS verification errors when certs rotate and connector hasn't refreshed
- Transient 502/503 when CP RPC queue hits backpressure

lina: For the CP load case we should surface an explicit 'retry-later' handshake response so connectors can backoff deterministically rather than hammering. Right now they interpret anything non-200 as immediate perm-fail.

sarah: Agreed. Proposal: handshake returns an explicit machine-readable envelope. Minimal fields: status, code, retry_after_seconds, cp_min_compat. e.g. {status: "ok|retry_later|fail", code: 200|429|502|403, retry_after_seconds: int?, cp_min_compat: "vX.Y"}.

ben: Addendum: connectors must attach an idempotency token on each handshake attempt so CP can dedupe retries and avoid duplicate state transitions. Token lifetime ~60s. Also recommend gRPC header "x-connector-retry" with attempt count.

ops: For TLS mismatches we should return `fail` with code 403 and reason "cert-mismatch". Connectors then trigger local cert-refresh + rotate flow and do NOT fallback to relay. We should log audit event `connector.fail.cert_mismatch` and page if >0.1% sustained.

lina: For load/backpressure: return status=retry_later with retry_after_seconds set by CP. Suggested algorithm on connector side: exponential backoff starting at 500ms, cap 20s; if CP provides explicit retry_after_seconds use that (but still apply small jitter). Pseudocode:

```
attempt = 0
while (attempt < 6) {
  resp = handshake();
  if (resp.status == "ok") return success;
  if (resp.status == "retry_later") {
    wait = resp.retry_after_seconds ?: min(20000, 500 * 2^attempt) + rand(0,250)
    sleep(wait)
    attempt++
    continue
  }
  emit_audit("connector.perm_fail", {reason: resp.reason, code: resp.code})
  break
}
```

sarah: Important policy: we MUST NOT silently fail over to regional-relay unless tenant config explicitly allows it. Two separate flags: `relay_fallback_allowed: true|false` and `egress_ip_flex: true|false`. Only when both true do we attempt relay fallback. Default = false for Private tenants.

ben: Also add a Console warning and API validation when enabling `relay_fallback_allowed` since it changes egress semantics. UX should show the expected egress IP delta and require confirm.

lina: Telemetry: expose `connector.handshake` counter with labels: tenant_id, outcome=(ok|retry_later|fail), reason, cp_version. Expose a histogram `connector.handshake.latency_ms`. Page on >0.5% fail rate over 15m or >3% retry_later over 5m.

infra-bot: Deploy log: connector-agent v1.8 rolled to eu-west canary at 2026-04-02T08:12:42Z. Observed handshake retry_later spikes at 2026-04-02T08:13:10Z.

ops: Rollout plan suggestion: RFC addendum -> implement server handshake envelope + idempotency header (CP + connector) -> canary with 10 tenants enabling verbose logs -> monitor metrics for 24h -> if stable, roll to remainder. Backout: revert connector to prehandshake branch if perm-fail spikes.

sarah: I'll draft the short RFC addendum and include sample connector code and the Console gating changes. CC @lina @ops.

ben: I'll add server-side support for cp_min_compat and dynamic retry_after_seconds in the next sprint.

sarah: Thanks all. I'll post the RFC link here when done. :white_check_mark:
